adaptations: The full named investigations become the chosen fixed campaign. Source five Urmahlullu forms, three memory shards, four list-givers, three Demons, three-hundred cultists, six tomb puzzles, three wanted outlaws and four named regalia pieces are explicitly selected. Market ring alternatives and random fishing become guaranteed personal challenges. The detailed midnight offerings and six puzzle solutions are chosen simple single-activation objectives rather than claims of recovered original mechanics; each needs concrete trigger bindings.
source_notes: This is an explicitly chosen Oteryn finite programme supplementary to the existing original SourceQuest identity. The original missions, interactions, claims, gates and UNKNOWN holds are retained; no duplicate canonical quest is created.

All quantities, requirement thresholds, sequencing, repeat policy and reward delivery are CHOSEN_OTERYN_APPROXIMATION, even when the same name or number occurs in a pinned source. Entity names are unresolved authored binding requests, never fabricated native IDs, Lua symbols or storage aliases.

Completion concerns only this chosen recipe. Unselected optional branches, full source fidelity, drop rates, original schedules, transport logic and executable Native delivery are not certified. Intermediate collect/use stages acquire and consume their own tools; reward_intents lists only final or stated milestone grants.
Original source identity: canary:quest/kilmaresh_quest@canary-04b83b51+crystalserver-9f5a72c6; inherited source pins and catalogue title links are preserved exactly.

Source journal missions are absent for this original record; the selected concrete programme uses named wiki locations/rewards and donor components with explicit adaptations, not inferred numeric-owner joins.

stages.objective: Accept Eshaya's investigation into the ambassador and Fafnar's Wrath.
Investigate the ambassador's house for evidence.
Defeat Urmahlullu's five forms in the chosen ring-acquisition challenge.
Use the Ring of Secret Thoughts to extract the ambassador's memories.
Present the three memory shards to The Empress.
Receive ingredient lists from Yonan, Tefrit, Narsai and Shimun for the midnight ritual.
Perform the chosen midnight pilgrimage with the ritual tools and offerings.
Defeat the three Demons on the Boards that Mean the World route.
Hunt three hundred Fafnar cultists as the chosen service target.
Catch a Small Tortoise as the gift for Narsai.
Solve the chosen six-part Ogre revenge tomb puzzle.
Help the stranded shark using the rescue net.
Recover an Eye-shaped Frame and Red Gem for the oracle.
Present the recovered artefact to Narsai and receive the sacrifice instructions.
Defeat Enusat the Onyx Wing after the chosen sacrifice.
Ask Eshaya and Kallimae about the Wanted investigation.
Blacken the Golden Hand Mirror and scratch it at the Nykri shrine while wearing the Ivory Mask.
Defeat Neferi the Spy as a wanted outlaw.
Defeat Sister Hetai as a wanted outlaw.
Defeat Amenef the Burning as a wanted outlaw.
Report the three outlaw victories to Eshaya.
Recover the four separate Regalia of Suon pieces.
Ask Yonan to assemble the four pieces into Suon's regalia.
Record the completion of the chosen Kilmaresh Quest programme and its selected reward intents.

recipe.summary: Restore trust in Kilmaresh and assemble Suon's regalia through the local investigations.
